integrity: The proof and standalone arithmetic checker are complete and reproducible from the included files; all experimental computations are finite, and no independent scientific audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The surface is defined over the complex numbers; characteristic-free chamber-volume claims are not made.
The geometry assumes five distinct plane points and exactly one collinear triple; it does not cover other weak del Pezzo root types.
Exhaustiveness of the negative-curve list is proven geometrically; computational enumeration only checks the resulting finite intersection matrix.
Historical priority is provisional against unindexed specialist tables or an equivalent published graph enumeration.
title: The 285 Zariski chambers of a one-nodal quartic del Pezzo resolution
